lines.text: Many learners say: My mother she is a teacher.
Better: My mother is a teacher.
Say the person once. Do not add she.
Is! My brother is a doctor.

data.wrong: My mother she is a teacher.
data.why: Say the person once. Do not add she.

native.hook: 主语说一次就够，别加 she！
native.tip: 中文常说“我妈妈她是老师”，英语里主语只说一次，后面不要再重复 she/he。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “My mother she is a teacher.”😅 中文常把主语再说一遍，英语里主语只说一次：“My mother is a teacher.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“is”，主语后面不要再加 he！免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Say the person only once: after my mother, do not add she.
en.caption: Do you say “My mother she is a teacher.” 😅 Say the person only once: “My mother is a teacher.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
